procedures.title: Burn
procedures.whenToUse: A small burn from heat that you can treat yourself.

steps.text: Move away from the heat. Remove rings or watches before swelling starts.
Cool the burn under clean, cool running water for 5 to 20 minutes.
Cover loosely with a clean, dry, non-stick dressing.

redFlags: The burn is larger than your palm.
The burn is on your face, hands or airway.
The skin looks white or charred.
It is a chemical or electrical burn.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.

sources.title: 2024 American Heart Association and American Red Cross Guidelines for First Aid
